name: gopersonal-search-resolver
title: GoPersonal Search Resolver
description: GraphQL resolvers for the VTEX search schema, with product search and facets powered by the GoPersonal search engine.

useGoPersonalSearch.title: Use GoPersonal as the search engine
useGoPersonalSearch.description: When unchecked, full-text queries are answered by VTEX Intelligent Search. Falls back to VTEX automatically when no GoPersonal project id is set.

facetsLocale.title: Filter sorting locale
facetsLocale.description: Locale used to sort filter names alphabetically, so accented letters land where the store's language expects them. Example: es, pt, en.

brandGroupName.title: Brand filter title
brandGroupName.description: Title shown above the brand filter. Product specifications with this same name are dropped, since they duplicate the brand the product already carries.

priceGroupName.title: Price filter title
priceGroupName.description: Title shown above the price range filter.

categoryLevelNames.title: Category filter titles, by level
categoryLevelNames.description: One title per category tree level, from the broadest to the deepest. Levels beyond the last one reuse the third name followed by their depth.

firstOfferedCategoryDepth.title: First category level offered as a filter
firstOfferedCategoryDepth.description: Category levels shallower than this are not offered as filters. Set it to 2 to hide the top level when shoppers already reached the page through it.

leadingGroupNames.title: Filter order
leadingGroupNames.description: Filter titles shown first, in this order. Every other filter follows them sorted alphabetically.

unpricedPlaceholder.title: Placeholder price to exclude
unpricedPlaceholder.description: Price the catalog stores for products that were never actually priced. Products at this exact price are left out of the price range filter, so a single one does not stretch the slider. Set it to 0 if the catalog has no such placeholder.
